name: goatcounter-dashboard
description: 🐐 A modern, beautiful dashboard for GoatCounter analytics - dark mode, interactive charts, demo mode, world map, responsive design. No server required.

paragraphs: An open-source alternative dashboard for GoatCounter analytics. Dark mode by default, interactive charts, fully responsive, and zero servers, zero build step, zero cost. It's a single index.html file that you can host anywhere (GitHub Pages, Netlify, your local disk).
features: Interactive charts: area chart for traffic, donut charts for browsers/OS/devices, horizontal bars for countries and languages.
Choropleth world map: countries shaded by visitor count (square-root scale so small markets stay visible), with hover tooltips and a gradient legend.
Demo mode: one click on the connect screen loads the full dashboard with realistic sample data. No API key, no account, no setup. Useful for trying before connecting and for sharing on social/forums.
Dark and light mode: defaults to your system preference, toggle persisted across sessions.
Flexible date ranges: Today, 7d, 30d, 90d, or a custom range.
